name: PROD: Progression to a New Course Is Silently Ignored (Flag Off)
description: Proves that with FeatureFlags.ShortCourseProgression OFF (the shipped, prod-like state), a second course code bundled in the same SLD POST as the learner's first course is silently ignored: CreateDraftShortCourseCommandHandler marks that item IsIgnored=true, no second ShortCourseLearning/Episode is created, and the API still returns a 2xx response. Run this story only with ShortCourseProgression disabled. A never-seen-before learner is POSTed with ZSC00001 (already completed) and ZSC00002 (a new course) bundled in a single OnProgramme array. Expect: 200 response, exactly 1 episode (ZSC00001 only), no episode for ZSC00002.

steps.name: SLD POSTs ZSC00001 (completed, unapproved) and ZSC00002 (new course) bundled, for a learner never seen before

assertions.name: Exactly 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Learning DB (ZSC00001 only)
No episode exists for ZSC00002 in Learning DB
Exactly 1 ShortCourseEpisode row in Earnings DB
